Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: the off-cycle request form link and its current criteria; that a regular HCM (not a super-user) sees Our Workforce and this quick action.

1 · Intro

When to use it.

When a transaction fails to pay through no fault of the employee, such as an Oracle glitch or a missed handoff, an off-cycle payment gets the employee paid before the next regular payroll.

Payroll pays these with Oracle's QuickPay process. Your part is the transaction and the request. This is the only way exempt staff get paid outside the monthly payroll.

Use this whenA transaction failed to pay and it was not the employee's fault.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Before you submit

The same four checks on every pay-impacting transaction. Draft: the owner for this area confirms anything marked To confirm.

Attach

  • The off-cycle paycheck request form Required

Check

Read every field back against the source document: person, effective date, position, hours, pay, and costing.

  • The Oracle transaction is submitted or resubmitted first.
  • The request meets the criteria shown on the form.
  • The reason matches what went wrong.
  • Payroll has the employee's name and ID, and when the transaction will be approved.

Cutoff

Off-cycle runs are on the HR/Payroll Calendar, with a cutoff of noon two days before each one. Payroll can't run the off-cycle payment until the Oracle transaction is approved. If the request does not meet the criteria on the form, the amount pays in the next regular payroll.

Who does what

  • Who starts it: You: the Oracle transaction and the form.
  • Who approves: Payroll decides whether the request qualifies.
  • What happens next: Payroll runs the payment and you tell the employee when to expect it.

Watch-outs

  • The form and the Oracle transaction go together. One without the other won't pay.
  • Off-cycle is the only way exempt staff are paid outside the monthly payroll.
  • The HR/Payroll Calendar lists the off-cycle paycheck dates, usually two a month. The cutoff for each is noon two days before.
  • Open item: list when to use each reason on the form.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Vanderbilt: Off-cycle paycheck request form (opens in a new tab)
  • Vanderbilt: Pay Calendar (People Experience) (opens in a new tab)

HCM Academy job aid · Payroll & Timecards

Request an off-cycle payment

Use when: A transaction failed to pay and it was not the employee's fault. · System: Oracle HCM + off-cycle request form

  1. Submit, or resubmit, the Oracle transaction, and wait for full approval.
    • Check its status: select the bell, then See more. On the notifications page, the Created by me tab shows what you submitted. Open it; the bottom of the window shows where it is in approval.
  2. Open the off-cycle paycheck request form.
  3. Select the reason.
  4. Confirm it meets the criteria shown on the form.
  5. Submit the form.
  6. Let payroll review it.
    • Close to the payroll deadline, you can email payroll and ask them to put the payment on their watch list.
  7. Confirm the payment.

Before you submit

  • Attach: The off-cycle paycheck request form (required).
  • Check: The Oracle transaction is submitted or resubmitted first. The request meets the criteria shown on the form. The reason matches what went wrong. Payroll has the employee's name and ID, and when the transaction will be approved.
  • Cutoff: Noon two days before the off-cycle run, and only once the Oracle transaction is approved.

Watch-outs

  • The form and the Oracle transaction go together. One without the other won't pay.
  • Off-cycle is the only way exempt staff are paid outside the monthly payroll.
  • The HR/Payroll Calendar lists the off-cycle paycheck dates, usually two a month. The cutoff for each is noon two days before.
  • Open item: list when to use each reason on the form.
